title: F001 rescope: DontPanic subtree mirror only; upstream sync operator-handled
body: F001 preflight surfaced a scope ambiguity that the v4 plan-doctor missed: original step language asked the implementer to bump agent-conventions/VERSION + commit upstream + subtree-pull, but the implementer worktree is scoped to /Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic and cannot reach /Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/agent-conventions/. The v4 F001 plan-doctor path-token regex `[\w./-]+\.\w+` misses extensionless tokens like `agent-conventions/VERSION`, so this slipped through lock-time validation. RESCOPE: implementer edits ONLY DontPanic subtree mirror at claude/shared/ (audit.schema.json + VERSION + CHANGELOG.md + Pydantic mirror at models/) + supervisor.py + tests. Operator handles upstream agent-conventions push out-of-band after F001 closes (cherry-pick changes into agent-conventions, tag v1.8.0, push). Step 8 added: explicit do-not-touch warning. Acceptance #8 added: no edits attempted outside DontPanic. v4.x candidate (doctor enhancement): widen path-token regex to catch extensionless filenames (VERSION, Makefile, Dockerfile, etc.) + scan plan.md narrative not just features.json steps.
